title: A click on a foam link opens the issue in decade
body:
A `foam:` link has a hover popup but does nothing on a click. `click` in `links.rs` runs a scheme's `click` command from `config.toml` when one is set, and the foam scheme sets none. A click on a `file:` link instead returns `Click::Show`, which sends decade a `show` request of the `file` kind. The pane whose program shows files opens it.

To open an issue today, a person needs foam already running in a pane, or a click command that starts it in decade's scratch pane. A workspace may have no scratch pane.

## Proposal

- decade knows a `foam` kind, as it knows `file`. A program that shows foam issues declares the kind in its hello's `shows`.
- A click on `foam:<id>` sends `show {kind: "foam", target: "<id>"}` to the pane that shows the kind, as a file link does.

## Open

- What program shows the kind: foam's own screen in a pane, or a decade program built on foam. That work belongs to decade and foam, and wants issues in their trackers.
- What decade does when no pane shows the kind: start a program that does, or report that none can.
- Which pane a click goes to. `LinksConfig::decade_pane` names one pane, for files.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/df584c97
notes.text: Jack: this waits on foam being integrated into decade, so that decade has a pane that can show a foam issue.
